articles.title: Russia cracks down on unlicensed crypto exchanges it claims are linked to Ukraine
articles.snippet: The FSB said at least 20 individuals were arrested in connection with a ring that scammed an undetermined number of Russian citizens.

articles.title: Bitcoin hovers below $65,000 as Middle East tensions escalate further
articles.snippet: Brent crude has meanwhile moved to over $83 a barrel after Yemen’s Iran-linked Houthis attacked Saudi Arabia, further escalating tensions in the Middle East.

articles.title: JPMorgan says Hyperliquid ETF inflows have stalled as competition mounts
articles.snippet: After leading crypto ETF inflows in May and June, demand for Hyperliquid funds stalled in July and August as competition intensified, the bank said.

articles.title: CleanSpark misses Wall Street revenue estimates as shares sink
articles.snippet: CleanSpark’s shares fell 5.5% on Thursday after the Bitcoin miner reported $138 million in quarterly revenue, narrowly missing Wall Street’s consensus estimate.

articles.title: Bitget explores licensed crypto presence in Bhutan
articles.snippet: Crypto exchange Bitget has signed an agreement with Gelephu Mindfulness City Authority to pursue a regulated local presence.
